question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
question_long: In the Nutrisigma feeding trial on Garole lambs, by what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
The cost per kg of gain in T1 was 169.94 and in the control group was 210. 

To find the percentage by which T1 is lower than the control group, we use the formula: ((control - T1) / control) * 100. 

((210 - 169.94) / 210) * 100 = (40.06 / 210) * 100 = 0.191 or 19.1%.
